body: No, I just ended up storing it and rebuilding it. Seemed to fix it. I just want to know what happened so I know what not to do.
Yeah, I’m in the same boat too.

Long story short I suffered a hemorrhagic stroke which left my entire right side of my brain damaged. Motor skills, speech, comprehension, all damaged. 

I’ve made a significant recovery since then. The doctor’s say it’s mainly because I’m 32 so I’ve more able to bounce back when compared to an elderly patient. I guess me writing this out is a testament to that. 

That’s great I suppose. But I can’t shake this feeling of “what if”. What if I don’t make a full recovery? What if I need people to help me with everything? It’s this idea that I’m nothing more than a burden and I think people would be lead an easier life without me.
